name: MegaGovern Free — AI Transparency Labels & Registry
author: MegaGovern

sections.description:
MegaGovern is a lightweight WordPress toolkit that helps website owners declare and display AI involvement across their content.

It provides visual transparency labels and a centralized content registry — all stored locally in your WordPress database.

Core Features

AI Content Declaration
– Declare content as Human, AI-Assisted, AI-Generated, or Synthetic Media/Deepfake
– Declaration meta box on posts, pages, custom post types, and WooCommerce products
– Bulk declaration actions

Transparency Labels & Badges
– Visual badges displayed on posts, pages, and custom post types
– Color-coded badges for each declaration type
– Configurable position (before/after title and content)
– WooCommerce product integration
– Media attachment labels

Content Registry
– Central database of all declared content
– Filter by declaration type, post type, and date
– Quick actions to declare/update content
– Bulk declaration management

Admin Dashboard
– Overview of declaration statistics
– Quick access to content registry
– Recent activity log

Local-First Architecture
– All data stored within your WordPress database
– No external API calls
– No license checks
– No feature locks

Why MegaGovern?

  • Simple: Focused on declaration and labels — no complexity.
  • Local-first: Your data stays on your site.
  • Transparent: Clear visual indicators for AI involvement.
  • Free: No hidden costs, no locked features.

AI Content Review Is Not AI Detection

MegaGovern does not claim to definitively determine whether content was generated by artificial intelligence.

The final transparency declaration remains under the control of the website owner.

Local-First Architecture

MegaGovern is designed to keep website content and transparency documentation within your WordPress installation.

The plugin does not require an external AI service to process your website content.

Free

All features are fully functional with no time limits, usage limits, or locked functionality.

Important Notice

MegaGovern provides transparency and documentation tools. It does not provide legal advice or guarantee compliance with any law or regulation.

Users are responsible for determining the legal and regulatory requirements applicable to their website, organization, and content.

Privacy

MegaGovern stores transparency-related information within your WordPress installation. This may include:

  • Content declarations
  • Registry data

MegaGovern does not require an external AI service to process your website content.

For more information about privacy and data handling, see:

https://megagovern.com/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the megagovern folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to MegaGovern settings to configure post types and label positions.
  4. Open the Content Registry to begin declaring content.
sections.faq:
Does MegaGovern detect AI-generated content?

No. MegaGovern is not an AI detector. It provides tools for website owners to manually declare AI involvement.

What types of AI involvement can I declare?

MegaGovern supports four declaration categories:

  • Human
  • AI-Assisted
  • AI-Generated
  • Synthetic Media/Deepfake

Does MegaGovern require an external service?

No. All data is stored locally in your WordPress database. No external API calls are required.

Where is my data stored?

All declaration data is stored within your WordPress database.

What content types does MegaGovern support?

MegaGovern supports posts, pages, custom post types, WooCommerce products, and media attachments.

How are transparency labels displayed?

Labels appear as color-coded badges before or after the title and content. You can choose the position in the settings.
